steps.name: Check signing support
steps.run:
echo "::error::Signing of the Mac app is not available yet (CAY-2997), run with sign-mac=false"
exit 1

steps.name: Check the dmg
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
hdiutil verify "$DMG"
MOUNT=$(mktemp -d)
hdiutil attach -readonly -nobrowse -mountpoint "$MOUNT" "$DMG"
trap 'hdiutil detach "$MOUNT" || true' EXIT
for f in \
    CayenneModeler.app/Contents/MacOS/CayenneModeler \
    CayenneModeler.app/Contents/Info.plist \
    "cayenne-$VERSION/LICENSE.txt" \
    "cayenne-$VERSION/NOTICE.txt" \
    "cayenne-$VERSION/RELEASE-NOTES.txt" \
    "cayenne-$VERSION/UPGRADE.md"; do
  if [ ! -e "$MOUNT/$f" ]; then
    echo "::error::$f is missing from the dmg"
    exit 1
  fi
done
if [ ! -x "$MOUNT/CayenneModeler.app/Contents/MacOS/CayenneModeler" ]; then
  echo "::error::The Modeler launcher in the dmg is not executable"
  exit 1
fi
ls -la "$MOUNT" "$MOUNT/cayenne-$VERSION"

pipelines.name: release dist

steps.name: Check the repository
steps.run:
echo "::error::Releases are built only in apache/cayenne, use dry-run to test in a fork"
exit 1

steps.name: Check the version
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
VERSION=$(mvn -B -ntp -q help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.version -DforceStdout)
echo "Tag: $TAG, POM version: $VERSION"
if [[ "$DRY_RUN" != "true" ]]; then
  if [[ "$VERSION" != "$TAG" ]]; then
    echo "::error::POM version $VERSION does not match the tag $TAG"
    exit 1
  fi
  if [[ "$VERSION" == *SNAPSHOT* ]]; then
    echo "::error::Can not release a SNAPSHOT version"
    exit 1
  fi
fi
echo "version=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
